تعتقلين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِلِينَ (taʕtaqilīna) /taʕ.ta.qi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# تُعْتَقَلِينَ (tuʕtaqalīna) /tuʕ.ta.qa.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
